clearedSpotChecks.check: evm2 e80df9c4 (reth main) DIV and MOD use ruint checked_div and checked_rem instead of the release's code, with the same results.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I fetched arithmetic.rs at e80df9c4: div writes a.checked_div(*b).unwrap_or_default() and rem writes a.checked_rem(*b).unwrap_or_default(). In ruint v1.21.1 div.rs, checked_div and checked_rem return None for a zero divisor and otherwise call self.div and self.rem, which impl_bin_op maps to wrapping_div and wrapping_rem. A zero divisor gives the default word 0, as the specification requires. reth main Cargo.lock pins ruint 1.21.1 (line 11290) and evm2 rev e80df9c4 (line 3759). The claim holds.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Battery and targeted vectors rerun for chain 1 on ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com (reth v2.11.0) with no mismatch.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I built 196 vectors of my own (ADDMOD, MULMOD, DIV, SDIV, MOD, SMOD, SIGNEXTEND, SAR, SHL, SHR, BYTE, EXP, SLT, SGT) from operands at 0, 1, 2^96, 2^128, 2^160 - 1, 2^192 - 1, 2^255 neighbours, 2^256 - 1 and the MIN and MAX sqrt prices, ran them as one batch of eth_call with code overrides on the same endpoint on 2026-11-27, and compared them with a Python reference: 0 mismatches, 0 errors. src passes gas() to calls and reads gas nowhere else (src/types/Currency.sol:48, :73, src/libraries/Hooks.sol:134), which agrees with the claim that the evm2 gas changes do not alter what a call returns.
